title: MV Two handed with dual wield trait

posts.author: KermexRPG
posts.body: Guys, can you helpe me here? I have two characters in my game that can equip two daggers or a bow, but with the dual wield trait I realized that is possible to equip those characters with two bows, I don't want that. Can this be fixed with any Yanfly plugin or something?

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body: A possible option without plugins is to put the Dual Wield trait onto the daggers themselves and then make it so daggers prevent equipping bows (and all other two-handed weapons).
